name: claude-consumption-vscode
description: Animated cyberpunk dashboard for Claude Code in VS Code: track agents, tasks, tokens, context, costs and memory from local session transcripts.

commands.title: Install the Status Line Bridge (5h / 7d quota)

enumDescriptions: Below the Claude Code chat, in the secondary (right) side bar. Falls back to "own" when the Claude Code extension is not installed.
In its own "Claude Consumption" container of the secondary (right) side bar.
The Claude Code sessions of the folders open in this window.
Every Claude Code session on this machine.
claudeConsumption.scope.description: Which sessions the panel follows. The tower is the most recently active session.

claudeConsumption.configDir.description: Claude Code configuration directory. Empty: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, otherwise ~/.claude.

claudeConsumption.pollSeconds.description: How often the transcripts are re-read, in seconds.

claudeConsumption.idleAfterSeconds.description: Without transcript activity for longer than this, the session is considered idle.

claudeConsumption.contextWindow.description: Context window size, in tokens, for the CONTEXT bar. 0: inferred from the model (1M for the 5 family, 200k otherwise, 1M when the model in settings.json carries [1m]) or read from the status line bridge.

claudeConsumption.compareWithDeepSeek.description: Adds a HUD row with what the same tokens would have cost on DeepSeek's most expensive offer (deepseek-v4-pro at peak rates: $1.32 per 1M input tokens on a cache miss, $0.044 on a cache hit, $3.96 per 1M output tokens), for the session, the week and the month, plus the Claude / DeepSeek ratio.

claudeConsumption.statusFile.description: File written by the status line bridge (5h / 7d quota, context). Empty: <configDir>/claude-consumption/status.json.
